fields.why: V14, decided on this article: a shortfall from the Healthy People 2030 target for Medicaid (SES-defined) enrollees (20 of 51 states) is a quantified contrast, framed by 'reduce tobacco-related disparities in this population', and state laws, Medicaid expansion and FFCRA are named as explanations, giving level 4.
The flag is derived from a level of 3 or more, so it follows the level verdict.
